'''Rysko Barnt''' was a frequent patron of the [[Cantina Oceana]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Dorumaa]]. He was hired by [[Thon Larimhor]] to pretend to be [[Kalani (individual)|Kalani's]] ex-boyfriend. When he beat her in the presence of [[Echari Di'San]], Di'San attacked and injured him. Witnesses at the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] believed that Di'San had murdered Barnt and an investigation was launched by the [[Cularin Office of Public Safety]]. It was later discovered that Barnt was actually murdered by Larimhor.

==Personality and traits==
Rysko Barnt was well known for his temper and for flying off the handle whenever he would lose control of the situation.
